config.op-devtools.sanitizer.showQuickOp: When enabled, choosing **Sanitizer** in **Actions** opens the quick options panel; start the run from the panel. When disabled, the sanitizer runs immediately from the tree.
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.toolType.ma:
Select the sanitizer tool. `npu-check` is only supported in `<<<>>>` operator projects: A2/A3 environments and other project types can only use `mssanitizer`, while `<<<>>>` operator projects on other environments default to `npu-check`.

| Tool | Configuration items |
|------|---------------------|
| `mssanitizer` | Memory, Memory Leak, Alloc Unused, Race, Uninitialized, Report Log Level, Max Single Log File Size, Detection Scope, Block ID |
| `npu-check` | Memory, Sync |
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.memory.mark: Memory: base detection. Illegal read/write, multi-core stomp, unaligned access, illegal free.
mssanitizer only. Memory leak detection (effective when Memory is enabled).
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.allocUnused: mssanitizer only. Unused allocated memory detection (effective when Memory is enabled).
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.sync.markdo: npu-check only. Sync Check: sync detection.
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.reportLogLe: mssanitizer only. Sanitizer report log level
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.blockId.des: mssanitizer only. Block ID when detection scope is single block (0–200)
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.maxSingleLo: mssanitizer only. Max single log file size. Integer `1-10240`, unit `MB`. Default `1024`.
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.detectionSc: mssanitizer only. Detection scope (`global` or `singleBlock`). Integer `0-200`. Before enable: memory/init/sync detect all blocks; race: inter-core all blocks, intra-core block `0`. After enable: memory/init/sync detect specified block; race: no inter-core, specified block intra-core.
config.op-devtools.sanitizer.enableMsAge: Enable msAgent AI fix for sanitizer (experimental)

When enabled, and the **msAgent** extension is installed, the sanitizer sidebar can offer **AI fix** actions and the latest sanitizer log is loaded into msAgent automatically after a successful run. When disabled or msAgent is missing, those controls stay hidden. msAgent is not bundled; install it separately until it is published to the Marketplace.
config.op-devtools.performanceTuning.sim: When enabled, choosing **Simulation analysis** in **Actions** opens the quick options panel; start the run from the panel. When disabled, simulation runs immediately from the tree.

Select the simulation tool. Effective only on A5 (`ascend950`) environments. `npusim` uses the new simulator and opens the data-collection config dialog; `msprof` keeps the legacy simulation flow. If unset, A5 defaults to `npusim` and other environments always use `msprof`.
Simulator type. See supported types under CANN path `ascend-toolkit/latest/tools/simulator`. If unset, a default matching the resolved SOC version is selected automatically.
Default: compute & move unit instruction time ratio.
Parameters are appended to command line. Run `msprof op -h` for options. `aic-metrics` is set in base config. Parameter name has `--` prefix by default.
config.op-devtools.performanceTuning.onB: When enabled, choosing **On-board analysis** in **Actions** opens the quick options panel; start the run from the panel. When disabled, on-board analysis runs immediately from the tree.

Select the on-board profiling tool. Effective only on A5 (`ascend950`) environments. `npu-compute` uses the new prototype tool and opens the data-collection config dialog; `msprof` keeps the legacy on-board flow. If unset, A5 defaults to `npu-compute` and other environments always use `msprof`.
Checking this collects all operator performance metrics by default.
Checking this collects all operator performance metrics by default.
Ascend 950 / A5 on-board profiling: PC sampling (`aic-metrics` PCSampling). Checking this collects all operator performance metrics by default.
Checking this enables all operator metrics. Unchecking this disables all operator metrics.
Collect cube and vector instruction time and ratio metrics.
Collect L2 cache hit rate metrics.
Collect compute and move unit instruction time ratio metrics.

Enable kernel code-segment profiling. For custom range, call [MetricsProfStart](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/83RC1/API/ascendcopapi/atlasascendc_api_07_1214.html) and [MetricsProfStop](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/canncommercial/83RC1/API/ascendcopapi/atlasascendc_api_07_1215.html) in kernel code. Confirm you have called both around the kernel code segment; otherwise this option has no effect.
Parameters are appended to command line. Run `msprof op -h` for options. `aic-metrics` is set in base config. Parameter name has `--` prefix by default.
config.op-devtools.environment.environme: Environment script. Absolute path to `set_env.sh` after CANN install. Empty if using one-stop platform image. If path error appears, set a valid env script path.
config.op-devtools.environment.socVersio: SoC version for project commands (for example: `ascend910b`, `ascend910c`, `ascend950`). If unset, it is selected automatically from the project, environment variables, or host detection.
config.op-devtools.environment.npuArch.m: `NPU_ARCH` used by AscendC compilation (for example: `dav-2201`, `dav-3510`). If unset, it is derived from the resolved SoC version; when set it overrides the derived value and is passed to `cmake -DCMAKE_ASC_ARCHITECTURES=` and `export NPU_ARCH`.
config.op-devtools.execution.commandTime: Operator command execution timeout in seconds. On timeout the whole process group is terminated and a timeout result is returned. Defaults to 1800; set to 0 to disable.
